_rules: Counters only increase. An ID is never reused or reassigned, including IDs of DEPRECATED items.
ids[] is append-only. Set retired: true instead of removing an entry.

fingerprint = `type|sorted source US-IDs|normalised title` (lowercase, punctuation removed, whitespace collapsed; stored unhashed because the agent has no hashing tool); used by update mode to match existing items before minting a new ID.

US-### IDs are minted only by the Requirements / PM agent in stories mode (counter US, committed immediately because story files are final output). IDs a human writes by hand are recorded in stories_seen and the US counter is raised past them.
